purpose: Reference values for validating the Lulea Raps-like model. Keep exogenous Raps/SCB assumptions separate from historical Raps model-run examples.

current_raps_context.note: DB25 is the current published Raps ground-database update. The public page documents the update but does not publish a current Lulea/FA baseline forecast.

primary_benchmark.type: Raps scenario assumption / SCB regional projection
primary_benchmark.use: External benchmark. This is the SCB regional projection used as a Raps scenario reference, not an endogenous Lulea/FA Raps result.

secondary_benchmark.note: Older database/scenario. Use only as a regression test of model mechanics, not as a current forecast target.

model_run_2.note: The handbook states that total population is balanced to the SCB national forecast in this run.

benchmark_policy: Current municipality/FA forecasts should first be compared to the current SCB regional benchmark for the same geography and year.
Tillvaxtverket handbook model runs are regression references only because their database and assumptions are older.
A future licensed/exported Raps DB25 baseline for Lulea or the selected FA region should supersede all indirect benchmarks.
